\section{Ontology and a minimal substrate}

A physical universe is not taken to be a point in one preferred
configuration space.  It is a coherent family
\begin{equation}
 \mathfrak U=\bigl\{(\mathcal A_R,\omega_R),
 \Phi_{R\to R'}\bigr\}_{R,R'}
\end{equation}
of regional and scale-dependent observable systems, states, and admissible
representation maps, equipped with compatibility, positivity, locality,
covariance, limit, and reconstruction certificates.

Gauge fields are charts on this relational structure.  Regulators are finite
realizations.  Renormalization maps express controlled forgetting.  The
continuum theory is a coherence class of compatible limiting realizations.
Particles, when they exist, are stable spectral modes of the reconstructed
dynamics.

\subsection{The simplest adequate substrate}

The simplest substrate that can realize all of these roles is a directed
region--scale network of finite operator systems and completely positive
maps.  Let
\begin{equation}
 \RegScale=\{(O,\ell): O\text{ is a region and }\ell\text{ is a scale}\}
\end{equation}
be a poset.  Attach an operator system \(\mathcal A_{O,\ell}\) and a positive
normalized state \(\omega_{O,\ell}\) to each node.  Regional inclusions are
represented by unital \(*\)-embeddings.  Coarse-graining observables is
represented by unital completely positive maps; the dual maps reduce states
and are completely positive and trace preserving.

In compact notation, exact coherence is a presheaf
\begin{equation}
 \mathcal U:\RegScale^{\mathrm{op}}\longrightarrow\OpSys.
\end{equation}
When finite representation errors must be retained, the appropriate object
is a lax functor with controlled two-cell defects.  For a composable triple,
one records
\begin{equation}
 \left\|\Phi_{02}-\Phi_{01}\Phi_{12}\right\|_{\mathcal O}
 \le \varepsilon_{012}(\mathcal O),
\end{equation}
and proves that the errors remain summable on the declared observable class.

This substrate is preferable to taking Hilbert spaces as fundamental for the
constructive stage.  Positivity is native; irreversible coarse-graining need
not be a homomorphism; commutative algebras reproduce classical probability;
and Hilbert space can be reconstructed later by GNS or OS procedures.  Gauge
changes act as natural automorphisms, while physical observables lie in the
appropriate invariant subobjects.

\subsection{Finite coherence example}

The executable supplement realizes the chain
\begin{equation}
 M_2\otimes M_2\otimes M_2\longrightarrow M_2\otimes M_2
 \longrightarrow M_2
\end{equation}
by successive partial traces on states and identity embeddings on
observables.  For the positive product state used in the certificate, the
two-step and direct state reductions agree to
\(5.56\times10^{-17}\), and the fine/coarse observable pairing agrees exactly
at machine precision.  This is only a finite kinematic realization.  It does
not supply Yang--Mills dynamics, locality estimates, or a continuum limit.
